description: This file defines the Minify_Source class, which represents a content source for minification in the Minify library. It includes methods for content retrieval, ID management, and content type guessing, as well as properties for file path, minification options, and last modification time.

classes.name: Minify_Source
classes.description: Represents a source of content to be minified, with properties for file path, content, minification options, and methods for content retrieval and digest calculation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Minify_Source instance with options for file path or content ID, content, last modified time, minifier, and minify options.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the source, reading from file or invoking a callback if necessary, and removes UTF-8 BOM if present.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the source.

methods.name: haveNoMinifyPrefs
methods.description: Checks if a set of sources have no specific minifier preferences.

methods.name: getDigest
methods.description: Generates a MD5 hash digest for a set of sources based on their IDs, minifiers, and options.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Guesses the content type (e.g., 'text/css') based on the first filename extension found among sources.
